candidates.description: This feature vector represents words related to impact, effect, and physical or conceptual influence.
This feature vector represents geographic regions, continents, and associated cultural or geopolitical adjectives.
This vector activates on common, active present-tense verbs indicating an action to be performed.
This feature vector represents common English given names, particularly those ending in the "ee" or "y" sound.
French demonstrative determiners and related proximal demonstrative pronouns.
This feature vector represents French auxiliary and linking verbs, primarily forms of "être" (to be) and modal verbs across various tenses and moods.
This feature vector represents French prepositions indicating time, place, or relation.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the letters 'ob' or related character sequences.
This vector represents common French adverbs and qualifiers of degree, quantity, or modal necessity.
This feature vector represents the concept of largeness, scale, or magnitude, primarily expressed through various French adjectives and terms denoting size.
